task.title: Diagnóstico: Troubleshoot WSL networking and stale dependencies
task.shortdesc: Este procedimiento conserva evidence, protege los datos de usuario y separa operator action de product defect. Diagnose Windows 10/11 through WSL access problems, Linux filesystem placement, and stale Python dependencies after source changes.

prereq.p: Este procedimiento conserva evidence, protege los datos de usuario y separa operator action de product defect. Use this procedure when Windows cannot reach a WSL-hosted BPM process, probes work inside WSL but not from Windows, file performance is unstable under /mnt/c, or dependencies appear stale after git checkout <approved-new-ref>.

context.p: Este procedimiento conserva evidence, protege los datos de usuario y separa operator action de product defect. WSL troubleshooting keeps Windows browser access, Linux process binding, filesystem placement, and Python environment refresh separate. BPM does not provide a native Windows service or installer in 0.9.0.

step.cmd: Diagnóstico 1: Confirm where the source checkout and virtual environment live.

info.p: Este procedimiento conserva evidence, protege los datos de usuario y separa operator action de product defect. Prefer the Linux filesystem for the checkout and .venv. Record whether files are under /mnt/c, which can change performance and permissions. Do not mix multiple checkouts during diagnosis.

step.cmd: Diagnóstico 2: Verify the WSL process binding and Windows route.

info.p: Este procedimiento conserva evidence, protege los datos de usuario y separa operator action de product defect. Check BPM_HOST="0.0.0.0", BPM_PORT="8000", curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health inside WSL, and browser access from Windows. If Windows fails, record firewall and port-forwarding evidence.

step.cmd: Diagnóstico 3: Refresh dependencies after source movement or revision changes.

info.p: Este procedimiento conserva evidence, protege los datos de usuario y separa operator action de product defect. Focused rerun: source .venv/bin/activate, python -m pip install --upgrade pip, and pip install -e ".[dev]". If dependency errors persist, record package names and source revision rather than editing installed packages manually.

step.cmd: Diagnóstico 4: Separate stale dependency symptoms from schema or database problems.

info.p: Este procedimiento conserva evidence, protege los datos de usuario y separa operator action de product defect. If import/export or validation fails after dependency refresh, use schema/cache and import/export troubleshooting. If profile visibility changes, use database/storage troubleshooting.

Este procedimiento conserva evidence, protege los datos de usuario y separa operator action de product defect. Do not create undocumented Windows services, move the database between filesystems, or claim native installer behavior.
info.note: If WSL networking remains ambiguous, stop external integrations and escalate with WSL distro, checkout path, bind address, Windows URL, and probe outputs.

result.p: El operador obtiene un diagnóstico clasificado, preserva user data y conoce el siguiente smallest rerun. The operator can distinguish WSL routing, filesystem placement, and dependency-refresh defects without changing product storage.

postreq.p: Tras corregir, vuelva al workflow Administrator/DevOps relacionado y repita solo los checks afectados. After WSL access is stable, return to source deployment verification and health-gated startup.
